summary: Mohamed Ibrahim, MP for North Galolhu, proposed a resolution asking MPs to state their view on the removal of Supreme Court judges from office. It says the Prosecutor General's Office decided on 30 September 2026 not to press criminal charges because the evidence did not show a crime, so the removals were based on unproven allegations. It argues that the Judicial Service Commission should take responsibility and be held accountable.
keyPoints: Cites Article 22 of the Judges Act (Law No. 13/2010), which requires a two-thirds vote of Parliament to remove a judge on the Judicial Service Commission's finding.
Notes that Parliament voted with 68 members on 14 May 2025 to remove two Supreme Court judges on the commission's advice.
The case was sent to police by the Anti-Corruption Commission and has now been filed by police after the no-charge decision.
Submitted under Article 189 of Parliament's rules of procedure, dated 11 October 2026.
